post_slowdown_asr_text: Takahiro's spirit said through a medium. She asked him to take her anywhere. Then she pointed at me. Kill that man. He pushed her away and asked if she should live or die. I nearly forgave him then, but she ran away. He cut one rope and left me. I got up beside the cedar and picked up her small dagger. She had dropped it there. I pushed it into my own chest. The bushes around me grew quiet. Someone came slowly towards me on silent feet. A hand I could not see quietly pulled the dagger from my chest.
